set.body:
Bounded format-admission spike: define the sample/event schema, null/unit/clock identity and metadata mapping for one small pymovements IPC/Feather fixture and an eyes4s round trip. Reuse existing codec/IO seams; evaluate supported JVM/JS options before adding a dependency. Acceptance: source-pinned fixture and schema, executable round trip or an explicit owner decision on the supported backend, corrupt/missing metadata cases. A schema-only result must leave implementation open with a bounded successor. Coordinate BIDS via its existing owner; do not conflate QC report export with BIDS ingestion.

Keep each implementation review below roughly half a day; if the scope exceeds that, split before implementation and retain the parent acceptance. Follow repository law/mutation and landing gates. This is required gap work owned by the comparison epic; completion needs evidence, not title closure.
set.title: PM1.8 Prove one typed Arrow IPC interchange round trip
